AgentInfo.description: What an AgentChip's tooltip says (handoff §6B.7): version, first seen, devices.
AgentInfo.title: AgentInfo

AgentLimits.description: A product's usage limits, as its newest response reported them (handoff §11J gap 5).
AgentLimits.title: AgentLimits

Coverage.description: Claude Code's own report (tengu_api_success) against what the proxy captured (handoff §5.4).
Coverage.title: Coverage

EventResponse.description: One analytics event in full (the EventRow expansion).
EventResponse.title: EventResponse

GapWindow.description: A not-captured window (hatched on the timeline), with the cross-check behind it.
GapWindow.title: GapWindow

LinkedAccount.description: One account of a person linked across agents (handoff §11J.5).
LinkedAccount.title: LinkedAccount

OrgStat.description: Whether the account's org is the customer's (handoff §11L.4).
OrgStat.title: OrgStat

OverviewResponse.description: The People page's top strip and agent cards (handoff §5.2.1).
OverviewResponse.title: OverviewResponse

PeopleResponse.description: Everyone seen, one row per person (handoff §5.2.2).
PeopleResponse.title: PeopleResponse

PersonRequestsResponse.description: Includes account calls with no session, and reported-but-not-captured model calls.
PersonRequestsResponse.title: PersonRequestsResponse

PersonSessionsResponse.description: Newest first. Range-filtered by overlap with [from, to]; paged.
PersonSessionsResponse.title: PersonSessionsResponse

PersonSummaryResponse.description: Every number follows the range (the brushed window), not the whole history.
PersonSummaryResponse.title: PersonSummaryResponse

PersonTimelineResponse.description: Bins are only emitted where there is activity; a missing bin is zero.
PersonTimelineResponse.title: PersonTimelineResponse

RangeCounts.description: The RangeReadout numbers; each matches its tab's total for the same range.
RangeCounts.title: RangeCounts

RequestDetailsResponse.description: Everything known about one request, for the All details tab.
RequestDetailsResponse.title: RequestDetailsResponse

RequestRawResponse.description: Headers (credentials redacted server-side), body and stream of one request.
RequestRawResponse.title: RequestRawResponse

RequestResponse.description: One request, captured or reported only (`reported:` ids).
RequestResponse.title: RequestResponse

RetryInfo.description: A failed attempt Claude Code retried (tengu_api_retry, joined by session, prompt and time).
RetryInfo.title: RetryInfo

SessionEventsResponse.description: `meta.total` counts every event in the range; `meta.shown` the rows left to page.
SessionEventsResponse.title: SessionEventsResponse

SessionFacts.description: Where and how a session ran (handoff §11J gap 1). None fields: not reported.
SessionFacts.title: SessionFacts

SessionHeader.description: The session row's fields, plus what the session page header adds.
SessionHeader.title: SessionHeader

SessionOrigin.description: Where a Codex thread came from (handoff §11J gaps 3, 4).
SessionOrigin.title: SessionOrigin

SessionPromptsResponse.description: Prompts (steps inline) and between rows, oldest first within the range; paged by item.
SessionPromptsResponse.title: SessionPromptsResponse

SessionRequestsResponse.description: The session's requests, oldest first by default, including not-captured model calls.
SessionRequestsResponse.title: SessionRequestsResponse

SessionStateResponse.description: Capabilities and experiments are as of `to`; everything else is within [from, to].
SessionStateResponse.title: SessionStateResponse

SessionTimeline.description: The whole session (the brush is client-side), with the session-only lanes.
SessionTimeline.title: SessionTimeline

SessionTimelineResponse.description: `presence` holds this terminal's focus and the device's sleep: focus lane = focused/away, sleep lane = asleep.
SessionTimelineResponse.title: SessionTimelineResponse

Status.description: Proxy and ingest health; drives the waiting checklist and the delayed banner.
Status.title: Status

StatusResponse.description:
For /status, `meta.lastDataAt` is the newest row of any kind, probes included:
the global badge reports whether the pipeline is flowing, not whether anyone is
active. Person and session scopes use their own rows.
StatusResponse.title: StatusResponse

ThreadChildren.description: The subagent and review threads started from a session.
ThreadChildren.title: ThreadChildren

TurnReport.description: Codex's own report on a turn (codex_turn_event, handoff §11J gap 6). Absent fields: None.
TurnReport.title: TurnReport

Unattributed.description: Sessions whose rows carry no account id on any call or event (handoff §5.2.1).
Unattributed.title: Unattributed
